scripts.build: turbo run build --filter=@ordermentum/asap-core && turbo run build --filter=!@ordermentum/asap-core --parallel
scripts.coverage: rm -rf .nyc_output coverage && turbo run coverage && yarn coverage:merge
scripts.coverage:merge: mkdir -p .nyc_output && cp packages/*/.nyc_output/*.json internal/*/.nyc_output/*.json .nyc_output/ && nyc report --reporter=lcovonly --reporter=text-summary --report-dir coverage
